name: The Gyre
blurb: Open river-meadow golf. Rolling fairways, broadleaf trees, and a river that never leaves your side.

name: Lake Pines GC
blurb: Pines, water, and a quiet lake. Tight corridors, pond carries — four par 3s over the drink.

name: Canyon Run
blurb: Eighteen through red canyon rock. Sandstone gates, mesa carries, and a finish at dusk.

name: Coral Cay
blurb: Island target golf. Every shot is a carry, every miss is the sea — and the harbor has stories on every cay.

name: Grassroots
blurb: Golf at an ant's eye. Grass like timber, toadstool gates, a canyon made of a soda can.

name: Gnome Hollow
blurb: Deep woods in steady rain. Mossy valleys, cliff drops, and cottages with the lights on.

name: Concrete Jungle
blurb: Golf down the avenues. Taxis in the landing zone, towers for trees, and a night nine.

name: Sheep Ranch
blurb: Links on the Oregon coast. Wide humpbacked fairways, waste sand, and the Pacific waiting.

name: Proving Ground
blurb: Eighteen trials, each one built to sharpen a different club in the bag.
